summary: Streamed BGM voice driven by Snd_StreamVoice_Update: a 64-entry 8-byte command ring at +0x1848, the async-read channel/buffer pairs at +0x34..+0x48 and the 0..8 state machine with its fade timer.
evidence: Snd_StreamVoice_Update consumes the ring at +0x1848 (read/write indices +0x1A48/+0x1A4C, modulo 0x40), switches on the state byte +0x1A50 (cases 0..8), advances the fade timer +0x1A54 and compares it with the target +0x1A58; async fills use Fs_SubmitAsyncTransfer into the 4-slot buffer mask +0x4C and ping-pong index +0x50.
